name: Hypertree Grid Isocontouring
definition: A method for generating isocontours on hypertree grids (adaptive mesh refinement with rectilinear geometry) using a dual-based approach to avoid the prohibitive memory and time costs of subdividing polyhedra into simplices.
summary: Hypertree Grid Isocontouring efficiently extracts surfaces from hypertree grids by leveraging hierarchical structure to pre-select cells, avoiding costly polyhedra subdivision.
